author: jiripolasek
title: CmdPal: Incremental loading fails when the initial batch does not fill the viewport
summary: The issue describes a CmdPal paging gap when the first 20-item batch cannot create a scrollbar. Two linked upstream hotfix PRs now cover underfilled viewport loading and the loaded-tail keyboard path; both are merged.

status.label: Existing merged fix
status.detail: The described underfilled-viewport behavior is covered by merged PR #51285, with merged paging follow-up #51287.

judgment.rationale: The concrete symptom—incremental loading never begins when the first result batch cannot make the list/grid scrollable—is the exact case covered by merged PR #51285. Merged PR #51287 adds paging when keyboard navigation reaches the loaded tail. Reuse this coverage rather than proposing a competing design.

comment.body: The underfilled-viewport case described here is covered by merged PR #51285, which loads further batches when the initial ListView/GridView content cannot scroll. Merged follow-up #51287 also covers paging when keyboard navigation reaches the loaded tail. This can be closed as handled by those changes; if the same scenario still reproduces on a build containing them, please reply with the PowerToys version and exact steps so it can be re-triaged.
